title: Luxury Candle Making Class Dallas
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Unleash your creativity in exclusive Luxury BYOB Candle Making Class, where art and science unite to craft your own custom-scented masterpiece. In just one hour, you'll work with eco-friendly soy wax and explore over 60 luxurious non toxic fragrance options under expert guidance. As you blend fragrances and learn the secrets of scent composition, enjoy a complimentary beverage that enhances this sensory journey. At the end, you'll leave with an 8oz candle uniquely yours, ready to delight your senses. Embrace this exceptional opportunity and let your imagination flow.
